svg.title: Window I
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, interpretive colours. Observed black bars and white support retained; wood/gesso texture and age omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/99.359/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
